verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

verses.ar: رَضِيتَ يَارَبُّ عَلَى أَرْضِكَ. أَرْجَعْتَ سَبْيَ يَعْقُوبَ.
verses.en: LORD, Thou hast been favourable unto Thy land, Thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob.
verses.kjv: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.web: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

verses.he: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֹ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: غَفَرْتَ إِثْمَ شَعْبِكَ. سَتَرْتَ كُلَّ خَطِيَّتِهِمْ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. Selah
verses.kjv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.web: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

verses.ar: حَجَزْتَ كُلَّ رِجْزِكَ. رَجَعْتَ عَنْ حُمُوِّ غَضَبِكَ.
verses.en: Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath; Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thine anger.
verses.kjv: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned [thyself] from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.web: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

verses.he: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: أَرْجِعْنَا يَا إِلَهَ خَلَاصِنَا، وَٱنْفِ غَضَبَكَ عَنَّا.
verses.en: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and cause Thine indignation toward us to cease.
verses.kjv: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.web: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

verses.he: הַלְעֹולָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.ar: هَلْ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ تَسْخَطُ عَلَيْنَا؟ هَلْ تُطِيلُ غَضَبَكَ إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ؟
verses.en: Wilt Thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt Thou draw out Thine anger to all generations?
verses.kjv: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.web: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

verses.ar: أَلَا تَعُودُ أَنْتَ فَتُحْيِينَا، فَيَفْرَحُ بِكَ شَعْبُكَ؟
verses.en: Wilt Thou not quicken us again, that Thy people may rejoice in Thee?
verses.kjv: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.web: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

verses.en: Show us Thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us Thy salvation.
verses.kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.web: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.

verses.he: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל ׀ יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י ׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁלֹ֗ום אֶל־עַמֹּ֥ו וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃
verses.ar: إِنِّي أَسْمَعُ مَا يَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ ٱللهُ ٱلرَّبُّ، لِأَنَّهُ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِٱلسَّلَامِ لِشَعْبِهِ وَلِأَتْقِيَائِهِ، فَلَا يَرْجِعُنَّ إِلَى ٱلْحَمَاقَةِ.
verses.en: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; for He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints; but let them not turn back to folly.
verses.kjv: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.web: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.he: אַ֤ךְ ׀ קָרֹ֣וב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁעֹ֑ו לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּבֹ֣וד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ خَلَاصَهُ قَرِيبٌ مِنْ خَائِفِيهِ، لِيَسْكُنَ ٱلْمَجْدُ فِي أَرْضِنَا.
verses.en: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.kjv: Surely his salvation [is] nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.web: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْتَقَيَا. ٱلْبِرُّ وَٱلسَّلَامُ تَلَاثَمَا.
verses.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed [each other].
verses.web: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.he: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃
verses.ar: ٱلْحَقُّ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنْبُتُ، وَٱلْبِرُّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ يَطَّلِعُ.
verses.en: Truth springeth out of the earth; and righteousness hath looked down from heaven.
verses.kjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.web: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

verses.he: גַּם־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטֹּ֑וב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: أَيْضًا ٱلرَّبُّ يُعْطِي ٱلْخَيْرَ، وَأَرْضُنَا تُعْطِي غَلَّتَهَا.
verses.en: Yea, the LORD will give that which is good; and our land shall yield her produce.
verses.kjv: Yea, the LORD shall give [that which is] good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.web: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

verses.he: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.ar: ٱلْبِرُّ قُدَّامَهُ يَسْلُكُ، وَيَطَأُ فِي طَرِيقِ خَطَوَاتِهِ.
verses.en: Righteousness shall go before Him, and shall make His footsteps a way.
verses.kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set [us] in the way of his steps.
verses.web: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
